title: Role-level cost attribution and billing view for Console
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: Customers struggle to understand which teams, roles, or service accounts are driving hosted inference spend. Current billing and cost dashboards show breakdowns by model and route but not by granting surface (roles, API keys, service principals). Without that visibility, platform teams cannot make principled access changes to reduce cost or investigate suspicious usage.

Goal: Prototype a Console view that attributes token/embedding spend and anomalous usage to role-level entities (workspace roles, role bindings, service accounts, invite links). The view should be privacy- and compliance-aware, tie back to audit log events, and surface recommended remediations (e.g., limit role scope, expire keys, rate-limit routes).

Scope: UX prototype covering: role-cost summary card, role-usage time-series, top routes/models per role, quick-action recommendations, linkages to audit-log playback, and a lightweight permission-edit affordance (redirect to Roles editor). Excludes implementing backend attribution logic; we will stub with synthetic data for prototype and align with Eng / Billing for feasibility.
acceptance_criteria: Clickable role list showing per-role cost (7-day, 30-day) with percent of workspace spend
Time-series visualization that can be filtered by model, region, and request-type (generation, embeddings)
Drill-down from a role to: top 10 routes/models, top API keys/service accounts used by that role, and most recent audit log events linking role grants or key creation
Inline recommended actions with one-click suggested playbooks (expire API key, reduce role scope, apply rate limit) that open the appropriate Console editor or modal
Prototype validated with PM and Eng for feasibility and security team approval for audit linking approach
review_feedback: 2026-02-25 - Rafael Ortiz (PM): Love the idea—ask to include cost impact per permission change (projected delta) in recommendations.

2026-03-03 - Priya Rao (Security): Audit linkage must avoid exposing raw token values and should provide only event references; suggested adding a redaction layer and requiring admin role to view full playback.
2026-03-08 - UX Review (Design team): Need stronger affordance for ephemeral keys and service accounts (visual priority) and to surface uncertain attribution with a confidence indicator.
